record.original_question: If κ is measurable, is there a forcing extension that preserves the measurability of κ and makes the positive relation \( inom{2^\kappa}{\kappa} 	o  inom{2^\kappa}{\kappa}^{1,1}_2\) hold? Likewise, can the same be done when κ is only strongly compact?

evidence.quote: Problem 3.3. Let κ be a measurable cardinal. Is there a forcing extension preserving the measurability of κ, in which (2^κ over κ) → (2^κ over κ)^(1,1)_2 hold? How about a strongly compact cardinal?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Recall the polarized (square-bracket-free) partition relation
$$\binom{\alpha}{\beta}\to\binom{\alpha}{\beta}^{1,1}_{2}$$
which asserts: for every coloring $c:\alpha\times\beta\to 2$ there exist $A\subseteq\alpha$ with $|A|=\alpha$ and $B\subseteq\beta$ with $|B|=\beta$ such that $c\restriction(A\times B)$ is constant.

Let $\kappa$ be an uncountable cardinal.

(a) Suppose $\kappa$ is measurable (i.e., there exists a $\kappa$-complete non-principal ultrafilter on $\kappa$). Does there exist a forcing notion $\mathbb{P}$ such that, in the generic extension $V^{\mathbb{P}}$:
- $\kappa$ remains measurable, and
- the positive polarized relation $\binom{2^{\kappa}}{\kappa}\to\binom{2^{\kappa}}{\kappa}^{1,1}_{2}$ holds?

(b) Suppose instead that $\kappa$ is strongly compact (i.e., for every set $S$ of size at least $\kappa$, every $\kappa$-complete filter on $S$ extends to a $\kappa$-complete ultrafilter on $S$). Does there exist a forcing notion $\mathbb{P}$ such that, in $V^{\mathbb{P}}$, $\kappa$ remains strongly compact and $\binom{2^{\kappa}}{\kappa}\to\binom{2^{\kappa}}{\kappa}^{1,1}_{2}$ holds?
artifact.category_tag: Polarized partition relations and large cardinals
artifact.status_search_result: Subsequent work by Garti and others has produced consistency results for the strong polarized relation $\binom{2^\mu}{\mu}\to\binom{2^\mu}{\mu}^{1,1}_2$ at supercompact cardinals and at singular limits of measurables, and there are related forcing constructions ("Forcing many positive polarized partition relations between a cardinal and its powerset"). However, no source located here explicitly resolves the specific question of obtaining the relation in a forcing extension preserving measurability (resp. strong compactness) of $\kappa$. The status appears to be unknown / not clearly settled from accessible sources.

status_evidence.title: Forcing many positive polarized partition relations between a cardinal and its powerset
status_evidence.snippet: Generic extensions in which polarized partition relations between a cardinal and its powerset hold.
status_evidence.claim: Related forcing results exist but do not directly state preservation of measurability/strong compactness of kappa together with the relation.

status_evidence.title: Some Remarks on Polarized Partition Relations
status_evidence.snippet: Strong polarized relation consistent for supercompact cardinals and for singular limits of measurables.
status_evidence.claim: Consistency for supercompacts and singular limits of measurables is known; the measurable/strongly compact preservation question is not addressed.
